question: When did NFL Red Zone launch and has it always operated without commercials?
transcript_excerpt: NFL Red Zone premiered in 2009 with Scott Hansen as host, replacing an earlier DirecTV version that started in 2005. The show has operated commercial-free since its 2009 launch until ESPN recently introduced ads during week 15 of the 2024 season.

question: How does NFL Red Zone produce live touchdown coverage when splitting screen for advertisements?
transcript_excerpt: Red Zone uses a production team monitoring multiple simultaneous games with producers and editors on each game feed. They build the broadcast package on a delay (typically 5-10 seconds) while commercials air, ensuring touchdown plays are captured and naturally integrated without viewers missing coverage or requiring explicit recaps.
